claimLimit: Frozen r2 filled command is unrun and must not execute; r4 supervisor static acceptance remains

finding.issue: The loader takes LAUNCH_START=time.monotonic(), then arms ITIMER_REAL for literal 210 seconds after intervening instructions. That alarm can fire after LAUNCH_START+210 while the r4 supervisor labels and computes the whole envelope from LAUNCH_START. There is no reviewed tolerance.
finding.location: LAUNCH.command Python bootstrap lines LAUNCH_START and signal.setitimer
finding.requiredCorrection: Version the command. Immediately before all pinned reads, compute remaining=210-(time.monotonic()-LAUNCH_START), require 0<remaining<=210, and arm ITIMER_REAL for that exact remainder; preserve r4 source/review/HEAD pins and independent exact review.
